items.title: Apple Enters the AI Agent Race as It Takes on OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta. What That Means for AAPL Stock.
items.summary: Apple is reportedly developing an autonomous AI agent capable of controlling apps, writing code, and completing complex tasks as competition with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta intensifies.

items.title: Apple Stocks Rise as AI Selloff Spares the iPhone Maker
items.summary: Apple gained while the Nasdaq briefly fell 4.6%, as investors favored device-based AI over cloud spending despite rising memory costs.

items.title: Apple, Exxon and Lowe’s Are Rewarding Shareholders Beyond Their Regular Dividends
items.summary: One of these three dividend payers yields just 0.30%, another has stopped buying back shares entirely, and the third just promised never to cut its payout. Each handles the cash differently, and the differences matter if you live on portfolio income.

items.title: The Economy Grew Way Faster Than First Reported: Q3 GDP Revised Up to 4.3%
items.summary: A blockbuster growth revision sounds like a green light for stocks, yet the market barely cheered. Behind the headline sits a boom that is narrower than it looks, plus an inflation reading that complicates the rate-cut story.

items.title: Can VZ's New Apple Deals and Loyalty Benefits Drive Subscriber Growth?
items.summary: Verizon's 2026 holiday deals feature iPhone 18 Pro offers, free Apple devices, affordable wireless plans and loyalty rewards to attract and retain subscribers.

items.title: If You Invest $1,000 in Apple Today, Here’s What It Could Be Worth by 2029
items.summary: Apple just posted its best fiscal year ever, yet Wall Street's consensus target sits below today's price. A five-year model maps three very different paths for your money, and one of them barely moves the needle.

items.title: Is Apple Stock Outperforming the Nasdaq?
items.summary: Apple stock has outperformed the Nasdaq over the past year and analysts are fairly bullish about its prospects.
